steps.headline: From first search to keys in hand

items.title: Choose the place
items.text: Start with the city and the street, not only the house. Tell your agent how you get to work, where you shop and what you want nearby, and they will narrow the list.

items.title: Walk the plan
items.text: View the home with the agent who knows it. Bring a tape measure and your questions. We will tell you the floor area, the age of the roof and anything we know that the photos don't show.

items.title: Check the details
items.text: Before you commit, your agent helps you book an inspection, read the disclosures and understand the closing costs, so you know what you will pay before you sign.

items.title: Get the keys
items.text: Your agent stays with you through the final walk-through and the closing, then hands over the keys with a folder of manuals, warranties and contacts for the house.
